\[
12960000 = 2^4 \times 3^4 \times 5^4
\]

\[
\sqrt[4]{2^4} = 2^{4/4} = 2
\]
\[
\sqrt[4]{3^4} = 3^{4/4} = 3
\]
\[
\sqrt[4]{5^4} = 5^{4/4} = 5
\]

Now, we multiply these results together:
\[
\sqrt[4]{12960000} = 2 \times 3 \times 5 = 30
\]

\[

\]
